d: Would you like to be part of a global organization? Explore our areas of expertise and discover the challenging career opportunities we offer at TMF. We are committed to helping you develop, excel, and achieve your goals.

TMF Group is a leading provider of critical administrative services, helping clients invest and operate safely around the world. We provide legal, financial and employee administration through TMF Group’s teams in 120 offices.
It is an area experiencing significant growth in TMF, thus providing an opportunity for great career development.
q: Saudi national, as required for Saudization compliance.
Bachelor’s degree in Law or a related field.
2–4 years of relevant experience in corporate legal services, company incorporation, corporate secretarial services, or a similar area.
Strong knowledge of Saudi regulatory frameworks and relevant authorities, including MISA, the Ministry of Commerce, the Companies Law, and CMA requirements.
Excellent attention to detail and strong legal and corporate document-drafting skills.
Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder-management skills.
Professional proficiency in both Arabic and English.
Microsoft Office and Digital Government Portals
Ability to manage multiple matters and prioritize work in a deadline-driven environment.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and on-ground teams.
High level of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and professional conduct.
Proactive approach to identifying regulatory updates, operational risks, and practical solutions.
Client-service mindset with the ability to explain legal and procedural requirements clearly.
Work with colleagues and clients around the world on interesting and challenging work.
We provide internal career opportunities, so you can take your career further within TMF.
Continuous development is supported through global learning opportunities from the TMF Business Academy.
You’ll be helping us to make the world a simpler place to do business for our clients.
Through our corporate social responsibility program, you’ll also be making a difference in the communities where we work.
Strong feedback culture to help build an engaging workplace.

We’re looking forward to getting to know you!
r: Prepare required legal drafts, including board and partners’ resolutions, powers of attorney, acceptance letters, non-objection letters, and other corporate legal documents.
Support the team with execution and legalization requirements, including reviewing and verifying executed and legalized legal drafts for completeness and accuracy.
Prepare articles of association in line with the legal form of the Saudi entity and applicable corporate laws and regulations.

Support company incorporation and ongoing corporate services, including trade name matters, account creation, license applications, amendments to articles of association, ownership transfers, changes of general manager, and license amendments.

Conduct business visits to government authorities to sign legal documents and bylaws on behalf of clients, where duly authorized, and submit official requests to the Saudi Business Center, the Ministry of Investment, and the Ministry of Commerce.
Liaise and coordinate with on-ground and Public Relations Officer (PRO) teams to support timely completion of client matters.
Maintain accurate corporate records, trackers, and document archives in accordance with internal document-control requirements.
Provide clients with ongoing support and act as a contact person for clarifications and discussions relating to corporate secretarial and government relations matters.
Conduct visits to government authorities, when required, to gather practical information relevant to new services and business lines.
Accompany clients to the notary public and the Ministry of Justice for the issuance of required powers of attorney.
Advise the team on requirements, procedures, government fees, expected timelines, and additional approvals or licenses relevant to client requests.

d: Albawani is one of the leading construction and contracting companies in Saudi Arabia.
Established in 1991, the company has grown from a small civil works contractor into a
major diversified group with operations across construction, infrastructure, engineering,
water and power, and industrial services. Headquartered in Riyadh, Albawani is recognized
for delivering large-scale commercial, healthcare, educational, and government projects
throughout the Kingdom. Albawani is known for its strong commitment to quality, safety,
and innovation, holding several international ISO certifications and a Class-1 contractor

Role Purpose: Responsible for managing and maintaining Albawani’s Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment to ensure secure, scalable, and high-performance cloud services that support business operations at headquarters and distributed construction sites across Saudi Arabia.
q: 3–5 years of experience in Azure and Microsoft 365 administration
Experience with hybrid cloud environments (Azure + On-Premises)
Knowledge of Microsoft Cloud governance and security best practices
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (required)
Microsoft 365 Admin or Azure Solutions Architect certifications
Oracle certifications in infrastructure or the OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) environment.
r: Deploy, configure, and manage virtual machines, storage, and networking components.
Manage subscriptions, resource groups, RBAC, and ensure governance.
Monitor performance and optimize resource utilization applying FinOps best practices.
Implement backup and disaster recovery solutions.
Manage Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive.

Implement Intune for endpoint management and security policies.
Manage Microsoft 365 licenses and optimize license usage.
Apply Azure and Microsoft 365 security best practices.
Support compliance with NCA cybersecurity and PDPL requirements.
Manage privileged access with PIM and Just-In-Time access.
Monitor and troubleshoot cloud services and infrastructure issues.
Document procedures, runbooks, and operational processes.
Coordinate with network and IT teams for cross-platform issue resolution.
Implement automation using PowerShell and Azure CLI.

d: MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We’re a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you’re passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.
We are looking for an experienced Senior Financial Crime Technical Consultant – AML/Fraud to join our growing team.

In this role, you will work closely with enterprise and financial institution clients to implement, configure and optimise financial crime prevention solutions. You will combine strong technical expertise with a solid understanding of AML and fraud risk management, translating business and regulatory requirements into effective technical solutions.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience implementing established AML/Fraud platforms, working with complex client data environments, configuring detection scenarios and supporting end-to-end solution delivery.
q: 5+ years of experience in technical consulting, solution implementation, systems integration or technical support within AML, fraud prevention or financial crime technology.
Mandatory hands-on experience implementing or supporting established AML/Fraud platforms such as NICE Actimize, SAS, Oracle Financial Crime and Compliance Management, FICO , or equivalent solutions.
Strong understanding of Anti-Money Laundering, fraud detection, transaction monitoring and financial crime risk management.
Familiarity with financial services operations, regulatory requirements and compliance processes.
Experience working directly with enterprise clients, preferably banks or financial institutions.
Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries, data analysis and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience with REST APIs, JSON and enterprise system integrations.
Experience with ETL processes, data mapping, transformation and data validation.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Java or similar.
Experience with BI and data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik or equivalent.
Understanding of database technologies, data architectures and enterprise application environments.
r: Configure and customise AML and fraud detection rules, scenarios, workflows and business logic to meet client requirements.
Implement and optimise financial crime prevention platform features and capabilities.
Develop and implement REST APIs, custom SQL queries and system integrations.
Support the configuration and integration of enterprise AML/Fraud solutions within client technology environments.
Work closely with client data and technology teams to integrate core banking, payment and other enterprise systems.
Design, configure and support ETL pipelines and data ingestion processes.
Perform data mapping, transformation, validation and reconciliation to ensure data quality and accuracy.
Troubleshoot data integration issues and ensure reliable data flows across connected systems.
Work with financial crime and compliance teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into technical configurations.
Support model validation, scenario testing, UAT and performance optimisation.
Analyse detection outcomes and assist in reducing false positives while maintaining effective risk coverage.
Work directly with client stakeholders to understand requirements, assess technical environments and recommend implementation approaches.
Collaborate with Engagement Managers, Product Managers, Data Scientists and Engineering teams to deliver successful client engagements.
Provide technical guidance, troubleshoot implementation challenges and support issue resolution.
Prepare technical documentation, implementation plans, configuration specifications and client handover materials.
Develop and maintain BI reports, dashboards and operational monitoring views.
Use data visualisation and reporting tools to provide insights into AML/Fraud detection performance and operational effectiveness.
Support clients in monitoring key performance indicators and identifying opportunities for improvement.

d: Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.

Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

We're looking for a Senior Operations Associate - Shops to own the performance of our Shops marketplace across the UAE and Jordan. This is a purely marketplace mandate so your world is Shops partners, their in-store picking teams, and the KPIs that determine a delightful customer experience. You'll sit at the intersection of Shops partners operations, strategic planning, and hands-on picking excellence.
q: 1-3 years in operations, quick-commerce, last-mile logistics, or retail/e-commerce marketplace roles, with at least 2 years managing teams and external partners directly.
Experience managing frontline or in-store operations (picking, warehousing, fulfillment) - you've been on the floor, not just in the dashboard.
Strong data fluency (Excel/SQL and BI tools) paired with the judgment to know when a number needs a conversation, not just a chart.
Willingness to travel regularly between the UAE and Jordan.
Must be fluent in English; Arabic fluency is preferred
We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.
r: Shops Partners Operations Performance. Own the end-to-end performance scorecard for Shops partners across UAE & JOR - order acceptance rate, prep time, order accuracy, cancellation rate, and customer contact rate and run the cadence that holds Shops accountable to it.

Strategic Planning & KPI Improvement. Translate performance gaps into a strategic roadmap: identify the top drivers of GMV leakage, AOV underperformance, and take-rate erosion, and build the initiatives that close them, from pilot to regional rollout.

Picking Operations Management. Manage the picking operation embedded within partner stores across UAE and Jordan - picker productivity, pick-to-pack time, and accuracy, including training standards, tooling, and process design that partners can actually run day-to-day.
Unit Economics. Build and defend the Last-Mile Unit Economics of every Shops partners cohort, working with Captain Operations to balance delivery cost, speed, and Captain earnings.

Business Reviews. Run quarterly and monthly business reviews with top Shops accounts, using cohort-level data (e.g., "Based on recent cohorts in Abu Dhabi and Amman...") to justify investment or intervention.
Peak Planning. Lead peak-season readiness planning for Ramadan and Dubai Shopping Festival - demand forecasting, Shops capacity planning, and picking-team surge staffing.
